info.title: MentorConnect / Smart Mentoring System API
info.description: Comprehensive REST API specification for academic mentoring, rule-based risk evaluation, marks immutability, session scheduling, PDF reporting, and Socket.IO real-time communication.

post.summary: Authenticate user and receive JWT tokens
Refresh expired access token with valid refresh token cookie
Invalidate refresh token and clear cookies

get.summary: Get authenticated student academic marks and semester breakdowns

put.summary: Update student semester marks and recalculate SGPA (Mentor/HOD only)

get.summary: Get student academic risk score breakdown and recommendations
Get active risk weights and thresholds (HOD only)

put.summary: Update risk engine weights and thresholds (HOD only)

post.summary: Recalculate risk scores for all students (HOD only)

get.summary: Get booked sessions for authenticated user

patch.summary: Update session status (scheduled, in_progress, completed, cancelled)

post.summary: Submit 1-5 star feedback and review for completed session
Send direct chat message to mentor or mentee

get.summary: Get chat history between authenticated user and partner
Generate official PDF Progress Report Card
Export student certificate portfolio as ZIP archive

post.summary: Bulk import students from CSV file
Bulk import students from Excel (.xlsx) file

get.summary: Get immutable system audit trail logs
Get linked ward academic progress and mentor contact
